fixture.description: The same primary after five Liveness cadences that reached no relay of its own Relay Set (spec §7.1, "Primary self-stop"): `state` is the one word `stopped` and there is NO `access`, because the workload's container is off. Nothing about the LEASE ended — `role` is still `primary`, `expires_at` is unchanged, and `.extend` still buys another interval — and the workload starts again if the relays come back before any member of the Standby Set has claimed the workload id. The request is the same question as `status.primary`, asked with a longer TTL so that it is a different event (§6.1).
